## Q. Omikuji doesn't appear in YouTube comments

- **All BOT comments, including omikuji, work via OneComme.**
- BOT comments are **displayed only on the Generator (browser source)**.
    - They are treated as an "effect" overlaid on your stream screen.
- **They are not posted to the YouTube or Twitch chat.**
    - They do not appear in viewers' chat at all, and are not kept in the comment history.
- Please note that BOT comments are an "on-screen effect seen on the stream", and that **this is not a BOT that writes to chat**.

### Is there a way to show BOT comments in YouTube chat?

- You can use [Nightbot](https://nightbot.tv/) or [CastCraft](https://castcraft.live/).
- For YouTube and Twitch only, you can also post comments using [SAMMI](https://sammi.solutions/).
